label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter 'BlCurated00055' flows directly into bar via replace("\"", """). The replacement only escapes HTML entity quotes, which is insufficient for preventing script tags (<script>). Since the resulting bar is concatenated unencoded into an HTML attribute context ('...'), an attacker can bypass quote escaping by omitting quotes entirely or using other XSS vectors, allowing malicious scripts to execute.

evidence.note: Parameter read from request and weakly sanitized (only quote escaping), then injected into HTML attribute without full encoding
